rows.label: tlk70000006_03_msg0001
rows.name:
The Armus settled down, so I came to
check on Tiko because I was worried.

rows.label: tlk70000006_03_msg0002
rows.name:
She acts like she's fine, but she's
actually scared. She's just putting on
a brave face.

rows.label: tlk70000006_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I know because at times like this, she
never looks me in the eyes.

rows.label: tlk70000006_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Hey, speaking of seeing things...
I saw you all fighting
the other day!

rows.label: tlk70000006_03_msg0005
rows.name:
You looked so cool! You just bashed
'em up like, POW! ...And SOCKK!
It was a real buzz to watch.

rows.label: tlk70000006_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Maybe I'll play Driver with the Armus
instead of doing experiments!
